name: lightning-vs-usbc
about: Quinn has an iPhone 15 case and needs a USB-C charger. Pia has a charger and wants that case, but hers is Lightning, so the exchange never draws the edge and nobody is even asked. When Ray lists a USB-C charger, Quinn and Ray trade. Pia stays listed.

people.name: Pia Russo
people.says: Have a lightning charger, need an iPhone 15 case.
people.reasons: Got a new phone for my birthday.

people.name: Quinn Adler
people.says: I have an iPhone 15 case. Need a type-c charger.
people.reasons: My new phone came without a brick.

people.says: Got a USB C charger, 30W, need an iphone 15 case.
